name: isom-graduate
description: ISOM Club student guide 2026/2027 — the printed course maps, and the graduation planner built from them.

scripts.render: cd guide && node render.js cover-b && node render.js mis && node render.js oscm && node render.js general && node render.js electives && node render.js transfer && node render.js numbers
scripts.verify: cd guide && node verify.js && node align-check.js
scripts.test: cd app && node test.js && node rules.js && node rules2.js
scripts.booklet: cd guide && pdfunite dist/cover-b.pdf dist/mis.pdf dist/oscm.pdf dist/general.pdf dist/electives.pdf dist/transfer.pdf dist/numbers.pdf dist/ISOM-student-guide-2026-2027.pdf
